title: Site data panel
description: The site's dataset tree in a side panel. Operators set these through settings overrides.

iconSvg.title: Panel icon
iconSvg.description: An SVG document (checked when the site is prepared).

dataUrl.title: Panel data
dataUrl.description: The panel's data file (tree source, registered examples and recipes), relative to the site root.

dataSha256.title: Panel data digest
dataSha256.description: SHA-256 of the panel data file; a file that does not match is refused.

defaultAction.title: Primary action
defaultAction.description: The data panel's labelled button and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter on a row.

startNotebook.title: Start notebook
startNotebook.description: One of the example notebooks (its path), opened when the Lab starts in place of the Launcher: the visitor's own copy, made once.

seedNotebooks.title: Example notebooks
seedNotebooks.description: Read-only notebooks on the site; opening one copies it into your files.

gridlook.title: 3D viewer (GridLook)
gridlook.description: Show a store on GridLook's globe (https://gridlook.pages.dev, in a sandboxed frame): Inspect's 3D Viewer tab and View on globe. Only stores readable without a token; the site's policy must allow the frame.
